issue.title: Bug: Arista-7060CX platform requires more time to come up after warm reboot in gnoi test

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the bug

The cpu on Arista-7060CX is older and slower than other models. It requires more time to come up after a warm reboot as a result. Currently the `wait_for_critical_processes` timeout in `gnmi/test_gnoi_system_reboot.py‎` is insufficient.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `gnmi/test_gnoi_system_reboot.py‎` on an Arista-7060CX and observe that the test times out waiting for critical processes to come up after a warm reboot.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

We observe that the wait for critical processes check will pass if the timeout is increased.
